reason: Integrates Command Code Go and eligible models into DSH through the provider API gateway, with API-key authentication, streaming generation, and dynamic model catalog synchronization.

summaries.zh: 通过 Command Code API 网关将 Go 计划模型接入 DSH，支持 API 密钥认证、流式生成和动态模型目录同步。
summaries.en: Connects DSH to eligible Command Code Go plan models through the API gateway with API-key authentication, streaming generation, and dynamic model catalog synchronization.

capabilities: Connects DSH to the Command Code API gateway
Sends model requests using a configured API key
Fetches and filters available models from remote model catalogs
